# Write Analysis Snapshot

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `stdlib.analysis.snapshot.task` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/stdlib.analysis.yaml` |
| Tags | analysis, intelligence |

Walks every tracked/untracked file in this workflow and emits a JSONL
snapshot with one record per file plus one record per YAML `id:` at any
depth. Replaces the legacy `_analyze_ids.py` script.
